subject.title: Surface Codex final answer candidates in activity

question: Should this answer-candidate Activity slice be ported into the current Control UI architecture, folded into the broader native-Codex progress work, or closed as no longer wanted?
rationale: The patch is useful and proven on the old UI tree, but current main has moved the relevant surface and the remaining choice is product/ownership direction rather than a narrow mechanical fix.

options.title: Port This Slice
options.body: Ask for or sponsor a rebase that adapts answer-candidate lifecycle display to the current UI event stream while preserving existing preamble progress.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Progress Work
options.body: Keep this PR open only as reference material and implement answer candidates together with the canonical native-Codex progress UX.

options.title: Close Direction
options.body: Close the PR if maintainers do not want a separate answer-candidate Activity surface.

recommendation.title: Port This Slice
recommendation.body: Ask for or sponsor a rebase that adapts answer-candidate lifecycle display to the current UI event stream while preserving existing preamble progress.

likelyOwner.reason: Root ownership and recent Control UI changes make steipete the best available decision owner for whether to port or fold this conflicted UI slice.
